Wen: The projector for Thursday is in the storage closet on the third floor. I will bring it down before nine.
Hal: Thanks. I booked the corner room from nine to eleven and added the client contacts to the invite.
Wen: Do we need the long HDMI cable or the short one?
Hal: Long. The table is far from the wall socket. I will grab coffee for eight people on the way in.
Wen: Perfect. I will print the agenda and leave copies on the chairs.
Hal: Sounds good. See you at half past eight.

extraction.mainQuestion: What substantive issue is being disputed?
caveats: Two people coordinating logistics for a meeting. Every exchange is a request or a confirmation; nothing is asserted that the other contests.
